nearest.description: Require set, actor, actor packet and primary reference. Optional reservation cleanup. Eligible candidates are unassigned when requested and outside the prepared view when radius!=0. Start best at float32 range squared for positive range, otherwise FLT_MAX. Strictly smaller float32 squared distance to either supplied reference wins. First ties survive; selection writes packet+a4 and owner byte.

farthest.description: Require set/actor/packet, then optional cleanup and same culling. Start best0. Primary distance must exceed best; secondary, when present, must also exceed best, then use the smaller distance. Range0 is unbounded; other range values, including negative, require distance strictly less than the unstored square. Failed range leaves previous best intact.

random.description: Count eligible first-pass candidates using supplied primary reference, optional culling and <= distance threshold. Positive range stores its square tofloat32; nonpositive uses FLT_MAX. If count>0 advance actual integerLCG95e5d4 and choose remainder modulo count. Second pass uses actor+5c position and omits culling while retaining reservation gating. Candidate ordinals can differ between passes: selection may choose a candidate rejected in pass1 or fail to reach the chosen ordinal. Never normalize the passes.

distance.description: Supporting nonnull scratch branch stores each difference and final sum tofloat32; products and ordered sums use x87 64-bit intermediate precision. This is already mapped elsewhere and earns no additional native-entry credit here.

native.method: Original selectors, reservation cleanup/index callback, distance scratch routine, sphere culling and both matrix helpers execute unchanged. Actual integer LCG state retained. Complete actor/owner/packet/locator/reference/camera input regions compared.

limits: Valid finite prepared world, locators, actor packet, view matrices and reference vectors. Float32 distance/range-square outputs stay finite.
Farthest/random require primary vector on active candidates; nearest has native null-primary gate.
No authored command credit until dispatcher integration; managed replay pending.
